source.original_question:
The graph shows an angle $a$ in standard position with its terminal side intersecting the figure at P.

Find the value of $\tan a$.

adaptations.reason: Uniformly scaled the original unit-circle coordinates by 5 for legibility; the displayed point and circle remain proportional, so the trigonometric value is unchanged.

independent_solution.method: Read P=(3,4), so radius=sqrt(3²+4²)=5. tan a=y/x=4/3.
